title: Printing without a main method in the initialized class
answer: A class can execute code such as a static initializer without declaring its own `main` method if some other entry point, framework, test, or reflective call causes that class to initialize. However, on a normal JDK 21 command-line launch, `java SomeClass` still requires an appropriate `main` method in the launched class. Therefore the accurate answer is that printing without `main` in that particular class is possible, but a standard standalone Java application still needs an entry point somewhere.
